q: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
note: The Sahara covers roughly the same area as the entire United States.

q: Which mountain is the highest point on Earth above sea level?
note: Its summit sits directly on the border between Nepal and China.

q: Which is the largest island in the world?
note: Australia is bigger, but geographers class it as a continental landmass rather than an island.

q: On which continent is the Atacama Desert?
note: Some weather stations in the Atacama have gone decades without recording measurable rain.

q: Which volcano buried the Roman city of Pompeii in AD 79?
note: The same eruption buried nearby Herculaneum, preserving both towns under ash for centuries.

q: Which peninsula do Spain and Portugal share?
note: Andorra and Gibraltar sit on the same peninsula, tucked into its edges.

q: Which mountain range is traditionally taken as the dividing line between Europe and Asia in Russia?
note: The Urals run roughly north to south for about 1,500 miles, from the Arctic coast to Kazakhstan.

q: Name the highest mountain in Africa.
note: Kilimanjaro is a dormant volcano in Tanzania that rises alone from the plain rather than as part of a range.

q: Which mountain range runs down the entire western edge of South America?
note: At roughly 4,300 miles, the Andes form the longest continental mountain range on Earth.

q: Which volcano erupted catastrophically in Washington State in May 1980?
note: The blast took roughly 1,300 feet off the top of the mountain and left a horseshoe-shaped crater.

q: Which desert stretches across southern Mongolia and northern China?
note: Unlike the Sahara, the Gobi is a cold desert where winter temperatures drop far below freezing.

q: On which Italian island would you find Mount Etna?
note: Etna is the most active volcano in Europe and has been erupting on and off for thousands of years.

q: Which mountain is the second highest in the world?
note: K2 straddles the China-Pakistan border and has a far higher climbing death rate than Everest.

q: Which island nation off the southeast coast of Africa is the world's fourth largest island?
note: Madagascar split from the African mainland so long ago that most of its wildlife exists nowhere else.

q: The Yucatan Peninsula lies mostly within which country?
note: The peninsula is honeycombed with cenotes, sinkholes that open into flooded limestone caves.

q: Which mountain is the highest peak in North America?
a: Denali, also known as Mount McKinley
note: The Alaskan peak rises to about 20,300 feet, and its older name means roughly "the tall one" in Koyukon.

q: What is the highest mountain in the contiguous 48 United States?
note: Whitney's summit in California stands less than 100 miles from Badwater Basin, the lowest point in North America.

q: Name the peninsula that makes up mainland Denmark and reaches into northern Germany.
note: Denmark's capital, Copenhagen, is not on Jutland at all but across the water on the island of Zealand.

q: Which coastal desert in southwestern Africa gives its name to a country?
note: Fog drifting in off the cold Atlantic is the main source of moisture for life in the Namib.

q: What is the largest peninsula in the world?
note: Saudi Arabia takes up the bulk of it, with Yemen and Oman along the southern rim.
